Global monotonically increasing ticket id; assigned in buyTickets and used for firstTicketId boundaries.
mapping(uint256 => Lottery) holding all lottery state (status, times, prices, rewards, counters).
mapping(uint256 => Ticket) storing ticket number and owner; owner zeroed on claim.

ERC20 token used for payments; never transferable via recoverWrongTokens.

Address allowed to run lottery lifecycle functions (onlyOperator).

mapping(uint32 => uint32) prefix constants (1,11,111,...) used to transform ticket numbers per bracket.
Ownable owner address; controls admin functions.
ReentrancyGuard status flag (_NOT_ENTERED/_ENTERED).
msg.sender: caller address used for authorization, ticket ownership and token transfers.
block.timestamp: used for lottery end time checks and lottery length validation.
tx.origin: compared with msg.sender in the notContract modifier.
External buyTickets: transfers tokens in, validates ticket numbers, records tickets and per-bracket counts.
External claimTickets: validates ownership/brackets, zeroes ticket owner and pays out rewards.
onlyOperator closeLottery: locks the first ticket id of next lottery and requests randomness.
onlyOperator drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable: reads randomness and computes per-bracket prizes/treasury amounts.
onlyOwner changeRandomGenerator: validates and replaces the random generator contract.
onlyOwnerOrInjector injectFunds: pulls tokens into an open lottery.
onlyOperator startLottery: validates parameters from timestamps/prices and creates a new Lottery.
onlyOwner recoverWrongTokens: transfers arbitrary tokens (not the main token) out of the contract.

Internal reward calculation comparing transformed winning and user numbers per bracket.
Internal bulk price computation with discount divisor arithmetic.
Uses extcodesize to check whether an address is a contract.
onlyOwner transferOwnership: transfers contract ownership.
onlyOwner renounceOwnership: sets owner to the zero address.
Returns the stored owner address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is checked by the notContract modifier in buyTickets.
msg.sender is checked by the notContract modifier and ticket ownership in claimTickets.
onlyOperator requires msg.sender == operatorAddress in closeLottery.
onlyOperator guards drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable.
onlyOwner guards changeRandomGenerator.
onlyOwnerOrInjector guards injectFunds.
onlyOperator guards startLottery.
onlyOwner guards recoverWrongTokens.
onlyOwner guards the price bound setter.
onlyOwner guards setMaxNumberTicketsPerBuy.
onlyOwner guards the operator/treasury/injector setter.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership.
notContract requires msg.sender == tx.origin in buyTickets.
notContract requires msg.sender == tx.origin in claimTickets.
block.timestamp gates buys against the lottery endTime.
block.timestamp must exceed endTime before closeLottery.
Lottery length is validated against block.timestamp in startLottery.
buyTickets' notContract modifier calls _isContract.
buyTickets calls _calculateTotalPriceForBulkTickets to compute the token amount.
claimTickets calls _calculateRewardsForTicketId per ticket.
calculateTotalPriceForBulkTickets delegates to _calculateTotalPriceForBulkTickets.
viewRewardsForTicketId calls _calculateRewardsForTicketId.
_lotteryId selects the lottery struct used by buyTickets.
_lotteryId selects the lottery struct used by claimTickets.
_ticketNumbers drive validation, counting and ticket creation.
_ticketIds select the tickets to claim.
_brackets drive reward computation and claim validation.
_amount is the injected token quantity.
_endTime - block.timestamp arithmetic and length bounds in startLottery.
_priceTicketInArchieneko is range-checked and stored in the lottery.
_treasuryFee is stored after being bounded by MAX_TREASURY_FEE.
_discountDivisor is validated against MIN_DISCOUNT_DIVISOR and stored.
_autoInjection decides whether leftovers roll into the next lottery.
_randomGeneratorAddress is validated and assigned to randomGenerator.
_tokenAddress selects the token to recover.
_tokenAmount is the amount transferred out in recoverWrongTokens.
_operatorAddress is validated and stored as operatorAddress.
_minPriceTicketInArchieneko updates the price lower bound.
_maxNumberTicketsPerBuy updates maxNumberTicketsPerBuyOrClaim.
_user selects the ticket list in viewUserInfoForLotteryId.
_cursor provides the pagination offset.
_size bounds the returned arrays.
_bracket is used for reward lookup in viewRewardsForTicketId.
_ticketId is used for reward lookup in viewRewardsForTicketId.
buyTickets reads and updates _lotteries status/endTime/amountCollected.
buyTickets increments currentTicketId for each ticket.
buyTickets writes a new Ticket into _tickets.
buyTickets increments per-bracket counters in _numberTicketsPerLotteryId.
buyTickets pushes the new ticket id to _userTicketIdsPerLotteryId.
claimTickets reads lottery bounds and bracket rewards.
claimTickets zeroes the owner of each claimed ticket in _tickets.
closeLottery updates the lottery status and firstTicketIdNextLottery.
closeLottery reads currentTicketId for the next-lottery boundary and seed.
closeLottery calls randomGenerator to request randomness.
drawFinalNumberAndMakeLotteryClaimable writes finalNumber and per-bracket rewards.
Winner counts are read from _numberTicketsPerLotteryId.
Reads viewLatestLotteryId and viewRandomResult from randomGenerator.
Sends treasury funds to treasuryAddress.
Writes pendingInjectionNextLottery when _autoInjection is true.
Uses _bracketCalculator to transform the final number.
changeRandomGenerator replaces randomGenerator.
injectFunds increases amountCollectedInArchieneko of the lottery.
startLottery creates the new Lottery entry in _lotteries.
startLottery sets firstTicketId/firstTicketIdNextLottery from currentTicketId.
startLottery seeds the lottery with pendingInjectionNextLottery then resets it.
recoverWrongTokens requires _tokenAddress != archienekoToken.
transferOwnership writes the new _owner.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
owner() returns the stored _owner.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulls tokens using caller-supplied lottery data; guarded by nonReentrant.
injectFunds performs an external safeTransferFrom of the ARCHIENEKO token.
claimTickets sends the accumulated reward via an external safeTransfer after effects are applied.
Treasury payout uses an external safeTransfer in the draw function.
recoverWrongTokens transfers an arbitrary token contract, allowing a malicious token to reenter this onlyOwner function (no nonReentrant guard).
closeLottery calls the external random generator with a keccak seed.
changeRandomGenerator calls getRandomNumber/viewRandomResult on the new generator.
msg.sender is the source address used in safeTransferFrom.
SafeERC20 safeTransferFrom ends in an Address low-level call on the token.
SafeERC20 safeTransfer ends in an Address low-level call on the token.
amountArchienekoToTransfer holds the computed price paid in buyTickets.
thisTicketNumber is the per-iteration ticket number in buyTickets.
rewardInArchienekoToTransfer accumulates payouts in claimTickets.
thisTicketId is the per-iteration ticket id in claimTickets.
finalNumber holds the RNG result in the draw function.
amountToShareToWinners is computed with multiplication/division that can overflow-revert.
amountToWithdrawToTreasury accumulates the treasury payout.
numberAddressesInPreviousBracket participates in bracket subtractions that can underflow-revert.
